Sandbox_Crepuscular_NightMode_tooltip: How night is decided. Fixed hours: night runs between the two hours below, every day of the year, whatever the Day/Night Cycle setting. Seasonal night: the game's own dusk and dawn, which move with the seasons and follow the Day/Night Cycle setting (endless day has no night, endless night is always night).
Sandbox_Crepuscular_NightStartHour_toolt: Hour of the day, 0 to 23, at which night begins when Night mode is Fixed hours. Night can run past midnight. If both hours are the same there is no night at all, and the log says so.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_NightEndHour_tooltip: Hour of the day, 0 to 23, at which night ends when Night mode is Fixed hours.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_BloodMoonChance_tool: Chance in %%, 0 to 100, that a full moon brings a blood moon. It is rolled once per full moon, when the first night on a full-moon date begins, and the blood moon lasts until that night ends. 0 never rolls, 100 gives one every full moon.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_BloodMoonAnnounce_to: Shows a line over each player when a blood moon begins.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_BloodMoonMutants_too: Only matters when The Mutants is loaded and The Mutants support is on. On: during a blood moon The Mutants is active all night, whatever Mutants active says: new mutants can appear and none are removed. Off: a blood moon follows Mutants active like any other night.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_MutantsAdapter_toolt: Only matters when The Mutants is loaded. On: The Mutants makes new mutants only while Mutants active allows it. At other times it makes none, and mutants with no target and no player nearby are removed from the world; they leave no corpse and don't come back. Monsters of Cry of Fear Monster NPCs (with Cry of Fear support on) and zombies in Excluded outfits are never turned into mutants. Off: The Mutants works as it does without Crepuscular.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_MutantsWhen_tooltip: When The Mutants may make new mutants. Day and night are Crepuscular's, set by Night mode, and follow a phase forced from the admin menu. At other times no new mutants appear, and far mutants are removed every in-game minute, because stored mutants come back whenever their area loads again. Always never removes any.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_MutantKeepDistance_t: While mutants are not active, a mutant is removed only if it has no target and no player is within this many tiles of it, in a straight line. 0 to 300. Keep it beyond what players can see, or mutants vanish in view.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_MutantRemovalsPerMin: Most mutants removed per in-game minute, 1 to 500. Every player's game is told to remove its copy of each one.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_MutantRequeue_toolti: On: when mutants become active, by Mutants active or by a blood moon with Mutants on blood moons, the zombies already loaded are offered to The Mutants, up to 200 per in-game minute, so the ones it picks turn into mutants at once. Some may change in plain view. Off: The Mutants only looks at a zombie when it is next created or loaded.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_CryOfFearAdapter_too: Only matters when Cry of Fear Monster NPCs is loaded. On: its monsters are never turned into mutants (with The Mutants support on), and the log warns at start if Cry of Fear's Night only option is off, which lets its monsters roam by day. Crepuscular never changes Cry of Fear's settings.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_ExcludedOutfits_tool: Outfit names of other mods' monsters, or the start of them, separated by commas, for example MyMonsters_,Cultist. Upper and lower case don't matter. With The Mutants support on, zombies wearing these outfits are never turned into mutants, and Crepuscular never removes them. The outfit is read from the zombie's saved outfit, so it also works before the zombie is dressed.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_DayOverrides_tooltip: Sandbox options to change while it is day. Write Table.Option=value;Table.Option=value, for example ZombieLore.Speed=3;ZombieLore.Toughness=1, and Option=value for an option without a table, for example HoursForCorpseRemoval=24. A value is a number, true or false, or text. When day ends the options go back to their base values. Unknown names and values the option refuses are logged and skipped. Options the game reads live change at once; options read when a zombie is created only affect new zombies; options another mod reads once at startup don't change.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_NightOverrides_toolt: Sandbox options to change while it is night, blood moons included. Write Table.Option=value;Table.Option=value, or Option=value for an option without a table. A value is a number, true or false, or text. When night ends the options go back to their base values. Unknown names and values the option refuses are logged and skipped. Options the game reads live change at once; options read when a zombie is created only affect new zombies; options another mod reads once at startup don't change.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_BloodMoonOverrides_t: Sandbox options to change during a blood moon, applied on top of the night values: an option in both lists takes this value. Write Table.Option=value;Table.Option=value, or Option=value for an option without a table. A value is a number, true or false, or text. When the blood moon ends the options go back to their base values. Unknown names and values the option refuses are logged and skipped. Options the game reads live change at once; options read when a zombie is created only affect new zombies; options another mod reads once at startup don't change.
Sandbox_Crepuscular_Verbose_tooltip: Writes phase changes, blood moon rolls, sandbox value changes, mutant removals and requeues to the log, prefixed [Crepuscular]. Warnings and errors are always logged.
